Frequently
Asked Questions

What can I bring onto a canvas?+

Bring images, visual references and video clips together in one workspace. Arrange them side by side as you explore your next idea.

Can I edit only part of an image?+

Yes. Mark the area you want to change, add an instruction and refine that region while keeping the rest of your image intact.

Can I create video from an image?+

Yes. Turn an image into a video, control motion and combine clips with the built-in timeline.

How do I take my work with me?+

Select the assets you need and download them from your canvas.

Do I need design experience?+

No. Start with a reference or an idea. Use plain language to create and refine, then arrange your work visually.
